Kaya Amaranth Habaron Actually, Feiglin says he is against civil marriage, at least as long as they negate Jewish religious rules.
He says he is in favor of giving all the rights to those couples (which mostly already happens today thanks to the supreme court), but against the Jewish state recognizing them as "married".

For him, the state has to uphold a complete Jewish identity, including shutting down the airport and public broadcasting on Shabbat.
